references.title: Box breathing
references.spoken_copy: Try four slow rounds: breathe in for four, hold for four, out for four, and hold for four.

references.title: Urge surfing
references.spoken_copy: Notice where the urge sits in your body and watch it rise and fall for ten minutes without acting on it.

references.title: Craving curve
references.spoken_copy: A craving can change in intensity over time; check the number again after a short coping step.

references.title: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
references.spoken_copy: In the United States, call or text 988 for immediate crisis support; call emergency services for immediate danger.

references.title: National Domestic Violence Hotline
references.spoken_copy: If it is safe to do so, call 800-799-7233 or text START to 88788 to reach a live advocate.
